scientific_integrity: The general bound is proved analytically; the included finite numerical examples only test the stated model and graph identities. Source relevance is compared without claiming independence or completeness of the literature.
scientific_limitations: The finding is an explicit nonmodular graph family with dense inter-block B-C edges; it is not a generic modular-network statement.
The discrete-time independent-state product map is an approximation, not the exact finite-state SIS Markov chain.
A near-onset equilibrium ratio is taken for each fixed graph size. Neither a uniform-in-size parameter window nor a sharp asymptotic coefficient is established.
Continuous-time near-threshold Perron asymptotics are established background and not claimed as new.
Unindexed and uninspected literature remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Quadratically unbounded reversal of local epidemic thresholds and endemic burden
